_comment: FR-013 (@readOnly), FR-014 (TPH discriminator), and FR-015 (@parameterRef) VALIDATION passes shipped in the Java port (ValidationPhase.validateFieldReadOnly / validateDiscriminator / validateSourceParameterRef). 9 of 11 fixtures now pass byte-identically. The two remaining entries are BOTH manifestations of one pre-existing Java subtype-field-override gap (orthogonal to the validation fan-out), deferred until the Java loader's field-override provenance/serializer reconciliation: (1) error-field-readonly-downgrade — the validation fires the correct ERR_READONLY_DOWNGRADE with a single error, but the envelope source for a subtype field that OVERRIDES an inherited field is a MergedSource pointing at the base declaration (children[0]) rather than the subtype's authored json source (children[1]); Java clones+stamps MergedSource on extends-overrides, and Contributor carries no per-contributor jsonPath, so the subtype's authored path is not recoverable post-merge (the TS/Python reference models keep the override's plain JsonSource). (2) field-readonly-upgrade-on-subtype — a positive fixture that fails on canonical serialization of the same subtype @readOnly override (same root cause).
_comment_ai_pilot: ai-trace-* fixtures now pass in Java (@responseRef + template.* child admitted)
_comment_fr024: FR-024 loader-grammar slice SHIPPED in this port (object.projection registration + dotted Entity.child extends-resolution + aggregate @via optional; FR024_PENDING manifest carve-outs hold until the atomic all-ports flip). extends-entity-field-cross-package and error-extends-entity-field-unresolved/-type-mismatch now pass natively. extends-entity-field-basic and the projection-* happy fixtures REMAIN ledgered on the PRE-EXISTING Java subtype-field-override serialization gap (MergedSource on extends-overrides — see _comment); they are extends-override-heavy by design. The FR-024 VALIDATION passes (identity pass-through, subtype rules, via inference/cardinality, agreement/providability) are still TS-only — those error fixtures stay ledgered until Phase-E validation parity.
_comment_fr024_b3: FR-024 B3 — identity names required + projection identity pass-through shipped in the TS reference port only; un-ledger in Phase E. projection-basic / projection-identity-fields-explicit use the object.projection subtype this port does not register yet; error-identity-name-required expects an error this port does not emit yet; error-projection-identity-not-extended / error-identity-key-mismatch expect FR-024 pass-through codes on object.projection inputs this port cannot load.
_comment_fr024_b4a: FR-024 B4a — value-purity + projection-licensing subtype rules shipped in the TS reference port only; un-ledger in Phase E. projection-extends-projection / error-projection-extends-entity / error-projection-source-writable use the object.projection subtype this port does not register yet, so it cannot load them. error-value-with-identity-secondary / error-value-with-source are plain object.value inputs this port CAN load — but it enforces only the legacy value-with-PRIMARY-identity rule today, not the full FR-024 value-purity rule (a value object carries no identity of ANY subtype and no source.*), so a secondary identity or a source.rdb on a value loads cleanly here while the fixture expects ERR_SUBTYPE_RULE_VIOLATION.
_comment_fr024_b5: FR-024 B5 — @via single-hop-unique inference + origin cardinality checks shipped in the TS reference port only; un-ledger in Phase E. origin-via-inferred-single-hop uses the object.projection subtype this port does not register yet (and an entity-hosted no-@via passthrough this port's validateOrigins cannot infer); error-origin-via-ambiguous expects ERR_AMBIGUOUS_PATH this port does not emit yet; error-origin-passthrough-to-many / error-origin-aggregate-no-to-many expect ERR_ORIGIN_CARDINALITY on object.projection inputs this port cannot load. Phase-E note: the TS registry flipped origin.aggregate @via to OPTIONAL (inferable, ADR-0029); the cross-port manifest still records required:true via the TS FR024_PENDING_REQUIRED_OVERRIDES carve-out — flip this port's AggregateOrigin @via registration to optional at fan-out.
_comment_fr024_b6: FR-024 B6 — extends/origin agreement + derived-field providability shipped in the TS reference port only; un-ledger in Phase E. error-extends-origin-mismatch uses the object.projection subtype this port does not register yet AND expects ERR_EXTENDS_ORIGIN_MISMATCH this port does not emit; error-derived-field-no-read-source is a pure-entity input this port loads cleanly (no providability pass yet), so it emits zero errors where the fixture expects ERR_DERIVED_FIELD_NO_READ_SOURCE; entity-derived-fields-multi-source is the spec §7 worked example whose countryName field uses the dotted Entity.child extends form (extends: "Country.name") this port cannot resolve yet, so it fails with ERR_UNRESOLVED_SUPER instead of loading. Phase-E note: until the B4b cutover removes view-PRIMARY entities, the providability rule counts a read-only-kind PRIMARY source as providable (legacy spelling) — port that accommodation with the pass.
